result.rationale: No direct closing evidence exists. I Squared signed for 100%, but Portland's required franchise-transfer ordinance was referred to full Council on 2026-08-06 and remained unscheduled. Zenith stays active; I Squared is SIGNED_PENDING_INCOMING with no 2025 entry year.

identityResolution.boundary: Standalone Portland terminal PortCo; do not merge with Zenith's broader platform.

owners.fund: ISQ Energy Transition Fund (EU) Euro SCSp (ETIF)
owners.vehicle: ISQ Springer Aggregator, L.P. > ISQ Springer Holdings, LLC

operatingResolution.capacity: 1,518,200 barrels operator-listed; buyer rounds to 1.7 million.
operatingResolution.products: Renewable fuels, SAF components/blends, biodiesel, aviation gasoline, distillates and crude oil during transition.
operatingResolution.customers: Portland customers NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED; broader Zenith platform reports 80+.
operatingResolution.permits: City pipeline franchise remains with Zenith; DEQ issued its air permit on 2025-10-09. Crude handling/storage must cease by October 2027; new infrastructure is restricted to permitted renewable, aviation and non-fuel uses.

pendingTransaction.seller: Zenith Energy Terminals Holdings LLC; ultimate acquired party Zenith Energy U.S., L.P.

acquisitionExitCheck.laterCheck: No completion, termination, amendment, recapitalization or replacement buyer found.
